requirements.text: Users post comments and replies on a resource; replies nest up to a depth limit
A reply's parent must belong to the same resource and tenant
Only authorized members can read or write a thread; other tenants see not-found
Authors edit within a window, and moderators can edit, hide or remove
Deleting a comment that has replies keeps the thread readable
Threads list newest first with a cursor, reply previews and reply counts
Bodies are validated and rich text passes through a sanitizer before storage

evidence.name: posting and threading: replies nest up to maxDepth and inherit the resource
a parent on another resource, another tenant or unknown is refused with one code
tenant isolation and authorization: other tenants see not-found
edit window: the author edits within it, then only a moderator may edit
soft delete clears the body, keeps replies and the thread readable
soft delete clears the body and keeps replies on PostgreSQL
list: newest first, opaque cursor, reply previews oldest first and reply counts
sanitize transforms stored rich text and empties are refused

implementations.notes: The sanitizer function is supplied by the application; the module applies it and refuses empty results
